name: PairDrop
longDescription:
PairDrop is local file sharing in your browser, inspired by Apple's AirDrop. Open it on two devices and send files, images or text between them, peer-to-peer over WebRTC, without any account or app to install. Devices on the same network find each other automatically. Devices on different networks can be paired permanently or meet in a temporary public room.

The server only helps devices find each other: files go directly from one device to the other and nothing is stored. PairDrop has no login.
description: Local file sharing in your browser, inspired by AirDrop: send files between devices peer-to-peer
